incident_text: Users are receiving portfolio-update notifications hours late, and some have not arrived at all today.

truth.description: aa-sync was CPU-throttled so its latency rose several-fold; the downstream consumer slowed and the portfolio-updates queue backed up, delaying notifications.

logs.msg: request processing slow: p95 {latency_ms}ms, cpu throttled in {cpu_throttle_pct}% of periods
memory resource limit alarm set on node rabbit@mq-0 ({memory_pct}% used)
memory resource limit alarm cleared on node rabbit@mq-0

trap: benign broker memory alarm earlier in the window, already cleared
